questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Their English level is not that high as in Denmark and another thing that's funny is that you have course with people on their master or 1 semester of bachelor as well.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Is more superficial, you are not able to work deeper with the course you only scratched the top of everything and then the course are much "smaller" than at home.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
English for intercultural relations (4 ECTS)

Introdution to gender and intersectionalities in peace and conflict studies (4 ECTS)
Cooperation and Collabore in writing groups (4 ECTS) 
Queer science and technology in pop culture (4 ECTS)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: They offer a lot of gender studies which is very interesting and then also course where you have the opportunity to work on assignment.
